subject.title: feat(ui): hold-to-record dictation on the composer mic button

question: Should the Control UI make hold-to-record dictation a default-on behavior change for every existing composer mic button, or should it ship opt-in until maintainers have accepted the interaction and upgrade behavior?
rationale: The patch adds a new persisted UI preference whose default changes the semantics of an established microphone control; source and tests cannot decide the intended product default.

options.title: Ship default-on after proof
options.body: Keep the proposed default, but require the provider-readiness repair and real browser/provider proof before merge.

options.title: Ship opt-in first
options.body: Default the new hold gesture off so existing users retain the exact mic interaction until they enable dictation in Settings.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the intended composer voice interaction and release messaging.

recommendation.title: Ship default-on after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed default, but require the provider-readiness repair and real browser/provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context identifies steipete as the implementation contact for the proposed behavior; merged-area ownership could not be established from the read-only inspection environment.
